sentences.text:
Date : 11.04.2023 Heard Mr. G.N. Sahewalla, learned Senior Counsel assisted by Ms. S. Todi,
learned counsel for the petitioner; Ms. P.R. Mahanta, learned Standing Counsel, Revenue Department for the respondent no. 1; Mr. B. Deuri, learned Junior Government Advocate, Assam for the respondent no. 2; and Mr. S. Bora, learned Standing Counsel, GMDA for the respondent no. 3.

It is the case of the petitioner that a parcel of land measuring 3 bighas 4 kathas 5 lessas, covered by Dag nos. 118, 120, 121 & 123 and K.P. Patta no. 27, located at Village - Gauripur, Mauza - Silasindurighopa belonging to the petitioner, has been acquired for 'Construction of bridge over river Brahmaputra connecting to Panbazar - North Guwahati' under the provisions of the Assam Land [Requisition and Acquisition] Act, 1964.

According to the petitioner, the provisions of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement [RFCTLARR] Act, 2013 are applicable in acquisitions of such nature.

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement [RFCTLARR] Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: The respondents were put to notice on 13.08.2019.
More than 3 years have elapsed but no response has been filed by any of the three respondents.

Today, Ms. Mahanta, Mr. Deuri and Mr. Bora have all prayed for 3 [three] weeks' time to file their respective counter affidavits traversing the contentions made by the petitioner in the writ petition.

As a period of more than 3 years have elapsed since the notices were issued to the respondents, it is expected that the respondents will show the earnestness to file the counter affidavits within 3 [three] weeks from today.
